# 2. MANAJEMEN DATA & FEATURE ENGINEERING (K3)
## 2.1 Helper Function RegEx untuk Ekstraksi Numerik

```{r}
# Helper 1: Membersihkan Harga_Teks menjadi angka numerik murni
clean_harga_regex <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x)) return(NA_real_)
  x_nodot <- str_remove_all(as.character(x), "[.]")
  digits <- str_extract_all(x_nodot, "[0-9]+")[[1]]
  if (length(digits) > 0) return(as.numeric(paste0(digits, collapse = "")))
  return(NA_real_)
}

# Helper 2: Membersihkan range Jarak_Tempuh menjadi nilai midpoint numerik
clean_mileage_regex <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x)) return(NA_real_)
  x_nodot <- str_remove_all(as.character(x), "[.]")
  nums <- as.numeric(str_extract_all(x_nodot, "\\d+")[[1]])
  if (length(nums) >= 2) return(mean(nums[1:2]))
  if (length(nums) == 1) return(nums[1])
  return(NA_real_)
}
```

## 2.2 Tahap 1: Deduplikasi, RegEx Feature Extraction, & Filtering Awal

```{r}
df_managed <- df_raw %>%
  # 1. Deduplikasi berbasis URL_Detail
  distinct(URL_Detail, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  
  # 2. RegEx Processing & Cleaning
  mutate(
    Harga_Clean     = sapply(Harga_Teks, clean_harga_regex),
    Odometer_KM     = sapply(Jarak_Tempuh, clean_mileage_regex),
    
    # Ekstraksi Liter Mesin dari Judul (misal 2.4, 1.5)
    Liter_Mesin     = as.numeric(str_extract(Judul, "\\b(\\d\\.\\d)\\b")),
    
    # Konversi Kapasitas_Mesin (Text Range) ke Midpoint CC
    CC_Mesin        = case_when(
      str_detect(Kapasitas_Mesin, "<1.000") ~ 850,
      str_detect(Kapasitas_Mesin, "1.000 - 1.500") ~ 1250,
      str_detect(Kapasitas_Mesin, "1.500 - 2.000") ~ 1750,
      str_detect(Kapasitas_Mesin, "2.000 - 3.000") ~ 2500,
      str_detect(Kapasitas_Mesin, ">3.000") ~ 3500,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    # CC Final (Hybrid: Liter_Mesin * 1000 jika ada, fallback ke CC_Mesin)
    CC_Final        = ifelse(!is.na(Liter_Mesin), Liter_Mesin * 1000, CC_Mesin),
    
    # RegEx Boolean Flags dari Judul
    Is_Garansi      = str_detect(Judul, "(?i)GARANSI"),
    Is_KM_Low       = str_detect(Judul, "(?i)KM\\s*LOW|LOW\\s*KM|ANTIK"),
    Is_Facelift     = str_detect(Judul, "(?i)FACELIFT|FL|LCI"),
    Is_Sport_Trim   = str_detect(Judul, "(?i)AMG|TRD|RS|SPORT|M-SPORT"),
    Is_Promo_DP     = str_detect(Judul, "(?i)TDP|DP\\s*\\d+|DP\\s*MURAH"),
    
    # Transformasi Usia Mobil
    Tahun_Num       = as.numeric(Tahun),
    Usia_Mobil      = 2026 - Tahun_Num,
    
    # Klasifikasi Brand Tier
    Brand_Tier      = case_when(
      toupper(Merk) %in% c("MERCEDES-BENZ", "BMW", "LEXUS", "AUDI", "PORSCHE", "MINI", "LAND ROVER") ~ "Luxury",
      toupper(Merk) %in% c("TOYOTA", "HONDA", "MITSUBISHI", "SUZUKI", "DAIHATSU", "NISSAN", "MAZDA", "HYUNDAI") ~ "Mass Market",
      toupper(Merk) %in% c("WULING", "CHERY", "BYD", "MG") ~ "Chinese EV",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    
    # Binning Odometer (Ordered Factor)
    Odometer_Group  = cut(
      Odometer_KM,
      breaks = c(-1, 20000, 50000, 100000, 1000000),
      labels = c("<20k (Sangat Low)", "20k-50k (Low)", "50k-100k (Sedang)", ">100k (Tinggi)"),
      ordered_result = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Outlier & Price Filtering Awal
  filter(
    Harga_Clean >= 30000000 & Harga_Clean <= 5000000000,
    !is.na(Odometer_KM)
  )

# Export otomatis file intermediate MANAGED2
write_xlsx(df_managed, "PSD_DATA_MOBIL_JAKARTA_MANAGED2.xlsx")
cat("File intermediate 'PSD_DATA_MOBIL_JAKARTA_MANAGED2.xlsx' berhasil disimpan (", nrow(df_managed), "baris).\n")
```

## 2.3 Tahap 2: Filter Murni DKI Jakarta & Pembersihan Final (drop_na())
```{r}
# Filter lokasi khusus DKI Jakarta & buang missing value
df_final_clean <- df_managed %>%
  filter(Provinsi == "Jakarta D.K.I.") %>%  # Buang data non-DKI
  select(
    Judul, URL_Detail, Provinsi, Kota_Kabupaten, Merk, Model, Brand_Tier,
    Tahun = Tahun_Num, Usia_Mobil,
    Harga_IDR = Harga_Clean, Jarak_Tempuh_KM = Odometer_KM, Odometer_Group,
    Kapasitas_Mesin_CC = CC_Final, Tipe_Bahan_Bakar, Transmisi, Tipe_Bodi, Warna,
    Tipe_Penjual, Is_Garansi, Is_KM_Low, Is_Facelift, Is_Sport_Trim, Is_Promo_DP
  ) %>%
  drop_na()                                # Pastikan 0 Missing Value

# Export otomatis file final bersih
write_xlsx(df_final_clean, "PSD_DATA_MOBIL_JAKARTA_FINAL_CLEAN.xlsx")
cat("File final 'PSD_DATA_MOBIL_JAKARTA_FINAL_CLEAN.xlsx' berhasil disimpan (", nrow(df_final_clean), "baris, 0 NA).\n")
```

## 2.4 Penyesuaian Tipe Data & Format Kolom

```{r}
df_clean <- df_final_clean %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ str_squish(str_replace_all(., "\u00a0", " ")))) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Is_"), as.logical)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Provinsi, Kota_Kabupaten, Merk, Model, Brand_Tier,
                  Tipe_Bahan_Bakar, Transmisi, Tipe_Bodi, Warna, Tipe_Penjual), as.factor)) %>%
  mutate(
    Harga_Juta = Harga_IDR / 1e6,
    Kapasitas_CC_valid = if_else(Tipe_Bahan_Bakar == "Listrik", NA_real_, as.numeric(Kapasitas_Mesin_CC))
  )

glimpse(df_clean)
```

# 3. EKSPLORASI DAN VISUALISASI DATA (K4)
## 3.1 Ringkasan Statistik Deskriptif (Peubah Numerik)

```{r}
skew <- function(x) { x <- x[!is.na(x)]; mean((x - mean(x))^3) / mean((x - mean(x))^2)^1.5 }
iqr_out <- function(x) {
  q <- quantile(x, c(.25, .75)); i <- q[2] - q[1]
  sum(x < q[1] - 1.5 * i | x > q[2] + 1.5 * i)
}

num_vars <- c("Harga_IDR", "Usia_Mobil", "Jarak_Tempuh_KM", "Kapasitas_Mesin_CC")

num_summary <- df_clean %>%
  select(all_of(num_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variabel", values_to = "nilai") %>%
  group_by(Variabel) %>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(nilai), SD = sd(nilai), Median = median(nilai), IQR = IQR(nilai),
            Min = min(nilai), Max = max(nilai), Skewness = skew(nilai),
            Pencilan_IQR = iqr_out(nilai), .groups = "drop")

kable(num_summary, digits = 2, caption = "Tabel 3.1: Statistik deskriptif peubah numerik")
```

## 3.6 Text Mining: Preprocessing & Wordcloud Judul Iklan

```{r}
teks_bersih <- df_clean$Judul %>%
  str_to_lower() %>%
  str_remove_all("https?://\\S+|www\\.\\S+") %>%
  str_replace_all("[^\\x20-\\x7E]", " ") %>%
  str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9 ]", " ") %>%
  str_squish()

tokens_all <- tibble(id = seq_along(teks_bersih), teks = teks_bersih) %>%
  mutate(token = str_split(teks, " ")) %>%
  select(id, token) %>%
  unnest(token) %>%
  filter(token != "")

stop_id <- c("dan", "atau", "yang", "yg", "di", "ke", "dari", "untuk", "dengan",
             "dgn", "dg", "the", "and", "of", "for", "new", "jual", "dijual",
             "mobil", "bekas", "second", "murah", "siap", "pakai", "bisa", "bs",
             "nego", "km", "rb", "ribu", "jt", "juta", "tahun", "thn", "th",
             "tgn", "tangan", "pajak", "pjk", "pkp", "plat", "nik", "tt",
             "ori", "original", "istimewa", "terawat", "kondisi", "mulus",
             "sangat", "asli", "harga", "cash", "kredit", "unit", "type", "tipe",
             "series", "edition", "stok", "ready", "free", "hub", "wa", "info",
             "cek", "only", "best", "deal", "no", "sd", "s", "sk")

kamus_norm <- c(mercy = "mercedes", benz = "mercedes", bergaransi = "garansi",
                automatik = "matic", automatic = "matic", at = "matic", mt = "manual")

tokens <- tokens_all %>%
  mutate(token = coalesce(unname(kamus_norm[token]), token)) %>%
  filter(nchar(token) >= 2,
         !str_detect(token, "^[0-9]+(rb|ribu|jt|juta|k|th|thn|tahun)?$"),
         !token %in% stop_id) %>%
  distinct(id, token)

freq_kata <- tokens %>% count(token, sort = TRUE, name = "n_judul")
```

```{r}
set.seed(2026)
wordcloud(words = head(freq_kata, 100)$token, freq = head(freq_kata, 100)$n_judul,
          scale = c(4, 0.6), random.order = FALSE, colors = brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"))
```

# 4. HUBUNGAN ANTAR PEUBAH & VARIABLE SELECTION (K5)
## 4.1 Matriks Korelasi Peubah Numerik
```{r}
num_data <- df_clean %>%
  transmute(Harga = Harga_IDR, Usia = Usia_Mobil,
            Jarak = Jarak_Tempuh_KM, CC = Kapasitas_CC_valid)

pasangan <- combn(names(num_data), 2, simplify = FALSE)
tab_kor <- do.call(rbind, lapply(pasangan, function(p) {
  x <- num_data[[p[1]]]; y <- num_data[[p[2]]]
  data.frame(Pasangan = paste(p, collapse = " ~ "),
             n = sum(complete.cases(x, y)),
             Pearson  = cor(x, y, use = "complete.obs"),
             Spearman = cor(x, y, use = "complete.obs", method = "spearman"),
             Kendall  = cor(x, y, use = "complete.obs", method = "kendall"))
}))
kable(tab_kor, digits = 2, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Tabel 4.1: Korelasi antar peubah numerik")
```

## 4.3 Variable Selection (Filtering Method)
Menggunakan kriteria Near-Zero Variance dan Eta-Squared (Kruskal-Wallis) untuk memilih fitur yang paling informatif.

```{r}
# 1. Daftar fitur kategorik (Keluarkan 'Provinsi' karena nilainya seragam murni DKI)
fitur_kategorik <- c("Merk", "Brand_Tier", "Tipe_Bahan_Bakar", "Transmisi",
                     "Tipe_Bodi", "Warna", "Tipe_Penjual")

# 2. Uji Kruskal-Wallis & kalkulasi Eta-Squared
rel_kategorik <- do.call(rbind, lapply(fitur_kategorik, function(v) {
  # Proteksi: lewati fitur jika kategorinya kurang dari 2
  if (length(unique(df_clean[[v]])) < 2) return(NULL)
  
  k <- kruskal.test(df_clean$Harga_IDR, as.factor(df_clean[[v]]))
  n <- nrow(df_clean)
  kgrp <- length(unique(df_clean[[v]]))
  eta2 <- unname((k$statistic - kgrp + 1) / (n - kgrp))
  
  data.frame(Fitur = v, N_kategori = kgrp, Eta_squared = eta2)
})) %>% arrange(desc(Eta_squared))

kable(rel_kategorik, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE,
      caption = "Tabel 4.2: Evaluasi Relevansi Fitur Kategorik terhadap Harga (Eta-Squared)")
```

```{r}
       x = "Brand Tier", y = "Harga (juta Rp, log10)") +
  theme_minimal()

kable(df_clean %>% group_by(Brand_Tier, Transmisi) %>%
        summarise(n = n(), Median_Harga_Juta = median(Harga_Juta), .groups = "drop"),
      digits = 0, caption = "Tabel 4.4: Median harga per Brand Tier dan Transmisi")
```

## 4.7 Brand Tier vs Bahan Bakar (Kategorik vs Kategorik)
```{r}
ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = Brand_Tier, fill = Tipe_Bahan_Bakar)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(title = "Komposisi Bahan Bakar per Brand Tier",
       x = NULL, y = "Proporsi", fill = "Bahan Bakar") +
  theme_minimal()

tb <- table(df_clean$Brand_Tier, df_clean$Tipe_Bahan_Bakar)
chi <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tb))
cramer_v <- sqrt(unname(chi$statistic) / (sum(tb) * (min(dim(tb)) - 1)))
```

## 4.8 Peubah Biner: Tipe Penjual, Garansi, Transmisi, dan Harga
```{r}
df_bin <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(manual    = as.integer(Transmisi == "Manual"),
         garansi   = as.integer(Is_Garansi),
         diler     = as.integer(Tipe_Penjual == "Diler"),
         log_harga = log10(Harga_IDR))

tab_bin <- data.frame(
  Pasangan = c("Transmisi manual ~ log10(Harga)", "Garansi ~ log10(Harga)", "Diler ~ Garansi"),
  Ukuran   = c("point-biserial", "point-biserial", "phi"),
  r        = c(cor(df_bin$manual, df_bin$log_harga),
               cor(df_bin$garansi, df_bin$log_harga),
               cor(df_bin$diler, df_bin$garansi))
)
kable(tab_bin, digits = 3, caption = "Tabel 4.5: Korelasi peubah biner")
```


# 5. VARIABLE SELECTION (FILTERING METHOD)
Menyeleksi fitur yang kurang relevan dengan metode filtering (memakai variansi, korelasi ke target, dan uji Kruskal-Wallis Eta-Squared).

## 5.1 Kandidat Fitur yang Dievaluasi

```{r}
fitur_numerik   <- c("Usia_Mobil", "Jarak_Tempuh_KM", "Kapasitas_Mesin_CC")
fitur_biner     <- c("Is_Garansi", "Is_KM_Low", "Is_Facelift", "Is_Sport_Trim", "Is_Promo_DP")
fitur_kategorik <- c("Merk", "Brand_Tier", "Tipe_Bahan_Bakar", "Transmisi", "Tipe_Bodi", "Warna", "Tipe_Penjual")

kable(data.frame(
  Jenis = c("Numerik", "Biner", "Kategorik Nominal"),
  Jumlah_Fitur = c(length(fitur_numerik), length(fitur_biner), length(fitur_kategorik)),
  Contoh = c(paste(fitur_numerik, collapse = ", "),
             paste(fitur_biner, collapse = ", "),
             paste(head(fitur_kategorik, 4), collapse = ", "))
), caption = "Tabel 5.1: Kandidat fitur yang dievaluasi")
```

## 5.2 Filter 1: Near-Zero Variance (Fitur Nyaris Konstan)
```{r}
nzv_biner <- sapply(fitur_biner, function(v) {
  p <- mean(df_clean[[v]])
  c(Proporsi_TRUE = p, Proporsi_minoritas = min(p, 1 - p),
    Freq_ratio = max(p, 1 - p) / min(p, 1 - p))
}) %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("Fitur")

nzv_kategorik <- do.call(rbind, lapply(fitur_kategorik, function(v) {
  tb <- sort(table(df_clean[[v]]), decreasing = TRUE)
  data.frame(Fitur = v, Kategori_terbesar = names(tb)[1],
             Proporsi_terbesar = as.numeric(round(tb[1] / sum(tb), 3)),
             Freq_ratio = as.numeric(round(tb[1] / tb[2], 1)))
}))

kable(nzv_biner, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Tabel 5.2a: Near-Zero Variance - Fitur Biner")
kable(nzv_kategorik, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Tabel 5.2b: Near-Zero Variance - Fitur Kategorik")
```

## 5.3 Filter 2: Relevansi terhadap Target (Harga)
```{r}
rel_numerik <- data.frame(
  Fitur = fitur_numerik,
  Spearman_ke_Harga = sapply(fitur_numerik, function(v) {
    x <- df_clean[[v]]; ok <- !is.na(x)
    cor(x[ok], df_clean$Harga_IDR[ok], method = "spearman")
  })
) %>% mutate(Abs_r = abs(Spearman_ke_Harga)) %>% arrange(desc(Abs_r))

kable(rel_numerik, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Tabel 5.3a: Relevansi Fitur Numerik terhadap Harga")

# Uji Kruskal-Wallis untuk fitur kategorik (Keluarkan Provinsi & proteksi <2 kelompok)
rel_kategorik <- do.call(rbind, lapply(fitur_kategorik, function(v) {
  if (length(unique(df_clean[[v]])) < 2) return(NULL)
  k <- kruskal.test(df_clean$Harga_IDR, as.factor(df_clean[[v]]))
  n <- nrow(df_clean); kgrp <- length(unique(df_clean[[v]]))
  eta2 <- unname((k$statistic - kgrp + 1) / (n - kgrp))
  data.frame(Fitur = v, N_kategori = kgrp, Eta_squared = eta2)
})) %>% arrange(desc(Eta_squared))

kable(rel_kategorik, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Tabel 5.3b: Relevansi Fitur Kategorik (Eta-Squared)")
```

## 5.4 Filter 3: Redundansi Antar Fitur Numerik
```{r}
cor_x <- cor(df_clean[, fitur_numerik], method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
kable(cor_x, digits = 2, caption = "Tabel 5.4: Korelasi Spearman antar fitur numerik (redundansi)")
```

## 5.5 Ringkasan Hasil Filtering
```{r}
semua_fitur <- c(fitur_numerik, fitur_biner, fitur_kategorik)
dibuang <- c("Is_Facelift")

ringkasan_filter <- data.frame(Fitur = semua_fitur) %>%
  mutate(
    Keputusan = if_else(Fitur %in% dibuang, "Dibuang", "Dipertahankan"),
    Alasan = case_when(
      Fitur == "Is_Facelift" ~ "Near-Zero Variance (frequency ratio tinggi)",
      TRUE                   ~ "Lolos filter variansi dan relevansi"
    )
  )

kable(ringkasan_filter, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Tabel 5.5: Ringkasan keputusan filtering seluruh fitur")
```
